notes.title: Update for Version 0.1.58
notes.content:
Now available in early access!  

Major issues still working on:
- Animated cut scenes still being polished but in the campaign in there entirety.
- Tutorial level still in a rough state with the boss not playable at this time. 

Minor Issues still working on:
- Smoothing out and juicing up boss fights
- Editing sound levels and finalizing sound effects
- Bug fixes

What to look forward to:
- All levels included and playable.
- Lots of weapons and parts to unlock
- An endless level to compete online against the world. 

Notes to remember - once the game is out of early access we will be wiping the online leader board to start seasonal competitive play.   

Let us know any issues or suggestions:
Forums - http://www.zugalu.com/forum/index.php?sid=6749f108c3c1f46dcfd78abab87bd673

Email info@zugalu.com

Thank you!
